complaintCategory.description: Complaint category, exactly one of two catalog values: 专线中断 (synonyms: 业务中断, 网络无法连通, 业务不通, 业务无法访问) or 专线质差 (synonyms: 业务卡顿, 业务访问超时, 业务丢包, 业务时延大, 业务抖动, 业务拥塞, 业务体验下滑, 业务误码率高, 业务光功率异常). Map the user's wording to the matching catalog value; when the stated category matches neither catalog value nor any listed synonym (e.g. 专线计费争议), report a format error.

occurrenceTime.description: Problem occurrence time, normalized to an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with the Z suffix, e.g. 2026-05-16T08:21:46Z. A stated local time carries an explicit timezone (e.g. 北京时间 (UTC+8)); convert it to UTC (2026-05-16T16:21:46+08:00 → 2026-05-16T08:21:46Z) and never strip the timezone; report a format error when no timezone is stated and when the phrase cannot be resolved to an absolute timestamp (e.g. 上周五早上八点多). When not stated at all, extract null without error (the field is optional).

ossEventId.description: OSS-side complaint ticket serial number of the private line service, kept verbatim, e.g. event-id-20260511-09013. When only a promise or placeholder is given instead of a concrete serial number (e.g. 具体编号我晚点发你, 流水号见附件, 流水号回头发你), report a format error.

complaintDetail.description: Complaint details stated by the user or pre-processed on the OSS side, kept verbatim. When not stated at all, extract null without error (the field is optional).
